endpoints.description: Returns API readiness plus dependency status (also mounted at /api/v1/health for client callers).

rest_exception.note: Plain GET /health for lifecycle systems, load balancers, and curl probes that cannot use a generated Connect client.

endpoints.description: Lists findings newest-first. Superseded are excluded unless include_archived; an explicit status filters to one lifecycle state.
Returns the finding (with citations) matching the request id.
Persists a citation-backed claim. Claim is required; confidence is clamped to [0,1].
Overwrites the claim and confidence of an existing finding; appends an audit row.
Soft-retires a finding (status=superseded, superseded_by=replacement). Never deletes; excluded from default search.
Moves a finding to DISPUTED with a dispute note. Disputed findings are returned by search with a flag.
Returns the DISPUTED findings — the dispute review queue's read side. Convenience over ListFindings(status=disputed).
Closes a DISPUTED finding: --resolution keep returns it to ACTIVE (clearing the dispute); --resolution supersede retires it in favor of --replacement. Writes an audit row.
Archives (hard-deletes) superseded findings. --dry-run reports what would be pruned.
Runs the aisearch-go read path over the findings corpus. Default excludes superseded; disputed returned flagged.

endpoints.summary: Count findings in a time window
endpoints.description: Counts findings captured within the requested canonical time window. Bound to the `findings count` measure.
Ratio of used to surfaced findings over the declared window.
Counts findings without an explicit use record over the declared creation window.
Pairs each finding with its usage telemetry (surfaced/used counts, last-surfaced age) and the blended effective score (age-decayed confidence × usage factor). The OT-P2-001 curation signal.
Records an explicit 'this finding was used' signal (distinct from the implicit surfacing counted automatically on search).

Runs the periodic full-store consistency pass: soft-retires never-surfaced, fully-decayed findings (confidence-gated) and reports cold-archive candidates, stale disputes, and orphans. --dry-run reports without mutating. Never hard-deletes; never auto-resolves a dispute.
Appends an evidence-linked correction and marks the active finding disputed without rewriting its claim history.
Lists append-only corrections linked to one finding.

endpoints.summary: Live web search (L0) with optional snippet synthesis (L1)
endpoints.description: Fans the query out to SearXNG and returns normalized results. With --synthesis, runs an optional always-cited LLM pass over the returned snippets (abstains rather than fabricates). Budget-governed: returns degraded without calling SearXNG when the live budget is exhausted.
Reuse sufficient stored evidence before live research; return complete citations and typed gaps.
Attach to the durable Agent Manager workflow without polling or canceling on timeout.
Explicitly cancels the owner-held Agent Manager execution and preserves its terminal cause.

endpoints.summary: L2 fetch, read, and single-pass cited synthesis
endpoints.description: Fetches the top-N result pages (HTTP-first, escalating to a browser-automation-studio capture for JS-heavy pages), extracts readable text, and produces one always-cited synthesis grounded in full page content (richer than L1 snippet synthesis, at higher latency). With --capture, distills the synthesis into the findings store (L2 capture is opt-in).

endpoints.summary: Start an L3 iterative research-and-reconcile run
endpoints.description: Spawns an agent-manager run that gathers nearby findings, researches the gap with L2 tools, and reconciles (distill, supersede outdated, flag low-confidence contradictions). Returns a run handle to poll. L3 auto-captures findings.
Returns the current status (and final summary when complete) of an L3 research run by id.

endpoints.summary: Bounded GATHER of findings near a query
endpoints.description: Returns the findings semantically near the query for the GATHER step of the research-and-reconcile loop. The sweep is bounded server-side (hard cap 20) — the L3 agent uses this instead of a free-form findings search, so it never scans the whole store.
Returns bounded pending, delivered, and failed Memory capture counts.
Returns owner-issued receipt metadata by opaque receipt ID.
Returns a bounded, integrity-addressed passage by opaque passage ID.
Returns an owner-issued claim assessment by opaque assessment ID.
Returns the owner-selected method revision and evaluation identity.
Promotes only a matching passing evaluation under an explicit grant and current-hash compare-and-swap.
Rolls back to a known release using current-hash compare-and-swap.
Suspends a method revision while retaining its release history.
